title: The Encryption Tightrope: Balancing Americans’ Security and Privacy: EventID=104573
summary: A 2016 House Judiciary Committee hearing on encryption, held during the Apple and FBI iPhone dispute. It features testimony from Apple, the FBI and outside experts including Susan Landau, and runs over five hours.
why: HN users cite it as primary-source testimony, especially for the argument that weakening encryption is security versus security, not privacy versus security.

quote.text: the recent House Judiciary Committee Hearing is worth the watch
